name: enterJS 2027
description: German enterprise JavaScript conference by heise and dpunkt
note: Conference, mostly German; Blind-Bird tickets on sale (price not shown); CFP until 2026-11-03
details: Enterprise JavaScript conference covering JavaScript, TypeScript, Angular, React, Node.js, AI, UX, performance and security/testing. Moves from Mannheim (2026) to KOMED in Cologne's MediaPark for 2027. Group discount from three people and student discounts; prices not shown on the pages read. Also runs online workshops and a one-day online event in October.
